scripts.text: This is Pat's home. This is where Pat first got into contact with Rekenber and met a staff member.
scripts.translation: 這裡是帕特的家。他就是在這裡第一次接觸雷根貝勒公司，並認識了一位職員。

scripts.text: Pat probably worked hard to get a chance out of poverty and live a better life. He wanted to start anew.
scripts.translation: 帕特大概一直很努力，想擺脫貧困、過上更好的生活。他想重新開始。

scripts.text: Heyo! There you are. Mom, Dad, how are you?
scripts.translation: 嘿！你們在這兒啊。爸爸、媽媽，最近好嗎？

scripts.text: Oh, he's the one who's been searching for Patrick a while ago.
scripts.translation: 哦，他就是之前一直在找帕特的人。

scripts.text: Aah, that's you! Did you meet... with Pat?
scripts.translation: 啊，是你啊！你見到...帕特了嗎？

scripts.text: Why'd you think they lose someone who was doing well in the Enterprise?
scripts.translation: 你覺得一個在公司裡幹得好好的人，怎麼會失蹤呢？

scripts.text: No, something is definitely not right! He's not the type of person that would ^0000FFjust stop contacting us.^000000
scripts.translation: 不，肯定有什麼不對勁！他絕不是那種會突然停止聯絡我們的人。 ^0000FF^000000

scripts.text: If you're not too busy, perhaps you could keep looking! I'm doing everything to send the paychecks all the way!
scripts.translation: 如果你不太忙，能不能繼續幫忙找找？我也一直在想辦法把工資寄回來！

scripts.text: It's how we're able to provide for Pat. But it's strange we haven't heard back from him yet.
scripts.translation: 們還指望這筆錢養活帕特呢。可奇怪的是，我們一直沒收到他的訊息。

scripts.text: Heeey~ Mom, don't fight with Dad.
scripts.translation: 嘿~ 媽媽，別和爸爸吵架。

scripts.text: I came here with a very high ^0000FFimportant^000000 member of your son's company. What did I tell you the other day? He's came to see the welfare of the families who have hired special talent.
scripts.translation: 我今天是陪你兒子公司裡一位重要人物來的。我之前不是說過嗎？他是來探望公司聘用的特殊人才的家屬。 ^0000FF^000000

scripts.text: Yes, that's him. You can ask him questions as much as you'd like. He came here for this sole reason.
scripts.translation: 沒錯，就是他。你們想問什麼都可以。他就是專程為這件事來的。

scripts.text: Hello~ I don't really know where to begin... Thank you for taking in my son, my family isn't worried having enough food to survive anymore. Thank you, thank you.
scripts.translation: 你好~我都不知道該從哪兒說起...謝謝你們僱用了我兒子。現在家裡至少不用再擔心吃不上飯了。謝謝，真的謝謝。

scripts.text: You may think my son isn't worthy but he's very good at fixing things.
scripts.translation: 你可能覺得我兒子沒什麼本事，但他很會修東西。

scripts.text: Thanks to the employment, I have a job and can feed my family now. I take pride in it.
scripts.translation: 多虧這份工作，我現在也有活幹，能養活家人了。我很珍惜這份工作。

scripts.text: But, we don't even know if he's alive or not.
scripts.translation: 可是，我們甚至不知道他還活著沒有。

scripts.text: I wonder whether or not I should go to the company and ask for him directly, I'm busy at work and I can't contact him.
scripts.translation: 我在想，要不要直接去公司找他。可我工作忙，也沒法聯絡上他。

scripts.text: I don't want to get in trouble with the company, I told my son to follow orders and not complain.
scripts.translation: 我不想和公司鬧僵，所以一直叫兒子服從安排、別抱怨。

scripts.text: If there's a problem on how things are going, please let us know. From his childhood, he's always been listening closely and he can fix anything.
scripts.translation: 要是事情有什麼不對勁，請一定告訴我們。他從小就很專注，也什麼東西都會修。

scripts.text: Please honey! You're not asking the important questions. Is there any regulation prohibiting my son from contacting us? I haven't contacted since the day my child was hired, I can't even contact him myself...
scripts.translation: 親愛的！你問的不是重點。公司有沒有規定不准我兒子聯絡我們？自從孩子受僱以來，我就沒聯絡上他，甚至連我自己都沒法聯絡他...

scripts.text: There are no regulations to restrict personal contact. We also pay holidays based on the government's recommendation... Your son says he's on vacation.
scripts.translation: 沒有規定禁止員工和家人聯絡。我們也按照政府的建議安排休假...你們的兒子說他正在休假。

scripts.text: So you mean to say Patrick wouldn't even come visit us?
scripts.translation: 所以，你的意思是帕特連回家看看都沒有？

scripts.text: Maybe he doesn't like us anymore... ^0000FFOn my first vacation^000000, I just came back to my family and talked to them.

scripts.text: Oh, I can do that when I'm at work!

scripts.text: What the hell are you doing with the Enterprise people! How come it's gone this far!
scripts.translation: 家！你們公司的人到底在搞什麼鬼？怎麼把事情弄成這樣！

scripts.text: Gosh! Mom, Dad! Thank you! So you can't even contact him, aren't you curious what's happening with him? I'm sure you are.
scripts.translation: 哎呀！爸爸、媽媽，謝謝你們！既然你們一直聯絡不上他，難道不想知道他出了什麼事嗎？我想你們肯定很想知道。

scripts.text: We'll meet with your son, keep going with our investigation and then contact you. You can both trust me and wait. You believe me right?
scripts.translation: 我們會去見你們的兒子，繼續調查，然後再聯絡你們。相信我，耐心等訊息，好嗎？

scripts.text: Oh my~ I can't believe it. Thank you so much. I'm afraid it will be hard for us to contact you...
scripts.translation: 哎呀~真不敢相信。太感謝了！只是我們可能很難聯絡到你們...

scripts.text: Aaah~ how to contact you! No matter what! Please contact us again, even if we're busy!
scripts.translation: 啊...要怎麼聯絡你們呢！不管怎樣，請一定再聯絡我們，就算我們忙也沒關係！

scripts.text: Did you hear all of that? As stated in the documents, they never even got a call after he joined the Enterprise. Well, I don't like seeing them like that, but I have to keep my first tourist promise.
scripts.translation: 你都聽見了吧？和資料裡寫的一樣，他加入公司後就再沒給家裡打過電話。我也不忍心看他們這樣，不過答應第一個遊客的事還是得辦到。

scripts.text: I'm sure the employees don't come visit their home during their vacations. Isn't it a ^0000FFprivacy matter^000000 that is none of our business?
scripts.translation: 我想員工休假時不一定會回家探親。這是個人隱私，和我們無關，對吧？ ^0000FF^000000

scripts.text: And you think it's like that for everyone in these documents? No way? Pat is a family person, do you really think he wouldn't come back home when he's on vacation because of personal problems? Do you really believe that?

scripts.text: Yes, you. Your guard doesn't look like someone who enjoys sitting in a hotel, so how about you? Don't you meet with the people you know during your vacations?

scripts.text: Yes, I often meet with my family during my vacations, sometimes even my friends.
scripts.translation: 是的，我休假時經常和家人見面，有時也會和朋友見面。

scripts.text: See? I knew it. Who wouldn't do that? Okay sure. Maybe one guy out of ten.
scripts.translation: 看吧，我就知道。誰會不這麼做呢？好吧，十個人裡也許會有一個例外。

scripts.text: The company doesn't investigate private matters. It's private for a reason. Ask yourself if you'd want someone else to look into your private matters.
scripts.translation: 公司不會調查員工的私事，隱私之所以叫隱私，自有道理。想想看，你願意讓別人調查自己的私事嗎？

scripts.text: Aah~ Do you want to meet with them for a few more minutes~ Will the VIP come here again?
scripts.translation: 啊~貴賓還想和他們多聊幾分鐘嗎~以後還會再來嗎？

scripts.text: I think I heard as much as I need to here. We'll find the rest of the information in the headquarters.
scripts.translation: 我覺得該瞭解的都瞭解了。剩下的資料去總部找吧。

scripts.text: The people who made these documents don't know anything about Pat. It's not just one or two persons on this list. Should you really listen to one person?
scripts.translation: 寫這些資料的人根本不瞭解帕特。這份名單上可不止一兩個人。你真的只聽信一個人的說法嗎？

scripts.text: Aren't you tired of walking this path narrow, steep path?

scripts.text: Are you tired already? There are people like this everyday. As your people suffer, more people suffer, so much that you can't even recognize pain.

scripts.translation: 你說那件事啊？我還不知道，不過我這次是陪副總裁來查清楚的。

scripts.text: Yeah, that's right. You have something to tell him? Go ahead!
scripts.translation: 沒錯，就是他。有什麼話想對他說就直說吧！

scripts.text: This will be good, I don't regret getting out of bed today!
scripts.translation: 今天起床真是起對了，居然能碰上這種事！

scripts.text: What happened to Marcus? Give me my Marcus back! It's been 2 years since I haven't heard from Marcus!
scripts.translation: 馬庫斯到底怎麼了？把我的馬庫斯還給我！我已經兩年沒收到他的訊息了！

scripts.text: You're looking for Marcus? Mar...cus... Holzman. He's from the East of Lighthalzen...
scripts.translation: 你在找馬庫斯？馬...庫斯...霍茲曼。他來自裡希塔樂鎮東部...

scripts.text: Oh, what a coincidence. He's also from the Lighthalzen slums!
scripts.translation: 哦，真巧。他也來自裡希塔樂鎮的貧民區！

scripts.text: Maybe he doesn't want to contact you anymore?
scripts.translation: 也許他不想再聯絡你了？

scripts.text: Marcus would never do that to me! My Marcus... Marcus...
scripts.translation: 馬庫斯絕不會那樣對我！我的馬庫斯...馬庫斯...

scripts.text: No matter what the truth is, I don't know a third person with the same issue as yours.
scripts.translation: 不管真相如何，我還沒遇到第三個和你有同樣遭遇的人。

scripts.text: Even if Marcus's thoughts about me had changed, he's not the only one!
scripts.translation: 即使馬庫斯對我的想法變了，他也不是唯一一個！大多

scripts.text: Most of the people from the slums that are hired by the Rekenber ^0000FFcannot be reached anymore.^000000
scripts.translation: 數被雷肯貝爾僱傭的貧民窟居民都再也聯絡不上了。 ^0000FF^000000

scripts.text: Do you really think everyone would change their minds like that? To their family? Their friends? Even lovers? It's a bigger issue!
scripts.translation: 你真覺得所有人都會這樣變心嗎？對家人、朋友，甚至戀人都不聞不問？這問題嚴重得多！

scripts.text: What the hell did Rekenber do with their employees?!
scripts.translation: 雷肯貝爾到底對員工做了什麼？！

scripts.text: I would like to know more details about this. Let's go back. If we make a disturbance here, they'll call the police.
scripts.translation: 我想進一步瞭解情況。我們先回去吧，在這裡鬧起來會驚動警察。

scripts.text: What? Do you want to throw me out?
Am I a problem to you? Do you think I'll give up easily? I will keep coming until I find Marcus!
scripts.translation: 你們添麻煩了嗎？你以為我會輕易放棄？找不到馬庫斯，我就會一直來！

scripts.text: She said he saw the VIP...
What are you trying to say?
You're a VIP. You're so beautiful, I'm very impressed. Tsk. Tsk. Tsk.
scripts.translation: 您就是貴賓啊。真漂亮，讓我佩服得五體投地。嘖嘖嘖。

scripts.text: Listen carefully. As I said before, joining Rekenber is the envy of most people in the slums. If you can't imagine how excited it is for them, then maybe you can't think.
scripts.translation: 仔細聽。正如我之前說的，加入雷肯貝爾是貧民區居民夢寐以求的機會。你要是想像不出他們有多興奮，那還真是缺乏想像力。

scripts.text: For such people, Rekenber has been giving out special gifts as part of social welfare, don't you know about it. Rekenber is tricking people.
scripts.translation: 雷肯貝爾一直打著社會福利的名義，給這些人發特別補助。你不知道嗎？公司是在騙人。

scripts.text: Are you disrespecting the company's welfare business? I get the same treatment as those who have been specially selected.
scripts.translation: 你是在質疑公司的福利政策嗎？那些特別選中的人和我享受的是同等待遇。

scripts.text: That's not what I'm saying VIP. The secretary here knows too. Do you really not know? Are you pretending?
scripts.translation: 貴賓，我說的不是這個。這裡的秘書也知道這件事。你真的不清楚？還是在裝傻？

scripts.text: Have you seen Rekenber's criteria for their special offer?
scripts.translation: 你看過雷肯貝爾特別補助的條件嗎？身體

scripts.text: People who have healthy body and no families. Among them, why would they only pick the poorest?
scripts.translation: 健康、沒有家人。在符合條件的人裡，他們為什麼偏偏只挑最窮的？

scripts.text: What do you think this means? Why only people with good health~ or no money~ then they disappear only to get paychecks to their house~
scripts.translation: 你覺得這說明什麼？為什麼偏偏挑身體健康~或家境貧困~的人？這些人失蹤後，公司卻還照常把工資寄回家~

scripts.text: But there's a single missing person around me.
scripts.translation: 可我身邊就有一個人失蹤了。

scripts.text: You're a guard? Your guard is from the borders of Rune-Midgard, right?
scripts.translation: 你是衛兵吧？你這位衛兵來自魯恩米德加爾特邊境，對不對？

scripts.text: It's easy to recognize a person from their personality and their tone of voice. It's easy for anyone to know, but I can see it just by looking at your face.
scripts.translation: 從人的性格和說話方式就能看出他的來歷。別人或許沒那麼容易看出來，但我光看你的臉就知道。

scripts.text: Speaking of personalities, I'm like a guard myself and our spirits can't be broken. You can't break me like a wheel, I'll fight back.
scripts.translation: 說到性格，我自己也像個衛兵，意志堅強，絕不會被擊垮。想打倒我？我可不會屈服，還會反擊。

scripts.text: I would rather use force than make compromises.
scripts.translation: 我寧願使用武力，也不願做出妥協。

scripts.text: Hah! That's it, that's the spirit. The type that day to day! You would have never allowed your friends to have gone missing just like that. Your personality is what saved our guard, for now anyway.
scripts.translation: 哈哈！就是這股勁！你果然是個乾脆利落的衛兵！朋友失蹤時，你絕不會坐視不管。至少到目前為止，是你的性格救了這位衛兵。

scripts.text: Anyway do you have a special unit in your guard? I know the answer already.
scripts.translation: 總之，你的衛兵中有特殊部隊嗎？我已經知道答案了。

scripts.text: I knew it. The VIP says you all get the same treatment. But he won't give security to the people of the slums.
scripts.translation: 我就知道。貴賓說你們都享受同等待遇，可貧民區的人卻得不到

scripts.text: The people in your team are the kind of people who don't go missing.
scripts.translation: 保護。你們隊裡的人可不會輕易失蹤。

scripts.text: Simply because it's more troublesome to make a guard disappear. It makes more noises.
scripts.translation: 因為讓衛兵失蹤要麻煩得多，還會鬧出更大動靜。

scripts.text: With the money and the welfare paychecks, isn't it easier to just make someone disappear from a vulnerable family and then make their voices unheard?
scripts.translation: 有錢，又有福利金打掩護，要讓弱勢家庭裡的人消失，再堵住家人的嘴，不是更容易嗎？

scripts.text: Do you even know what you're insinuating now? It's all speculations!
scripts.translation: 你知道你在暗示什麼嗎？這全是猜測！

scripts.text: Do you really know what I'm thinking?
scripts.translation: 你真的知道我在想什麼嗎？

scripts.text: Come in and check it out yourself!
Let's see why they never made contact. I don't know what they did during their vacations, but we can see where they are now.
scripts.translation: 看他們為什麼一直沒有聯絡。我不知道他們休假時做了什麼，但至少能查出他們現在在哪裡。

scripts.text: Hah, this guy, he's still all about privacy. Are statistics and odds not part of the economy? Why do all of these people go and never contact their house again?
scripts.translation: 哈，這傢伙還在講隱私。統計和機率不算經濟學的一部分嗎？這麼多人出去後就再也不聯絡家裡，難道不奇怪？

scripts.text: Why are they giving their salaries?
scripts.translation: 為什麼他們還在發工資？

scripts.text: Our adventurer asked a good question. They are almost all from the slums. In Rekenber, they offer you accommodations, with meals and lodging, you hardly have to spend any money at all.
scripts.translation: 冒險者問得好。他們幾乎都來自貧民區。在雷肯貝爾工作，公司會提供食宿，你幾乎不用花什麼錢。

scripts.text: If the adventurer is from a poor family, and you have to support it, would you spare money for your meals?
scripts.translation: 如果冒險者出身貧寒，又需要供養家人，你還會把錢花在吃飯上嗎？

scripts.text: These accommodations for the low-income classes is Rekenber's contribution to society. We do our best!
scripts.translation: 公司為低收入者提供住宿，這是對社會的貢獻。我們已經盡力了！

scripts.text: Ahah! Was I not polite enough? Our VIP is getting angry~ But the adventurer and I have gone to many places before, we know these things.
scripts.translation: 啊哈哈！是我不夠禮貌嗎？我們的貴賓要生氣了~ 不過冒險者和我之前去過很多地方，我們懂這些。

scripts.text: It's an illegal laboratory. You know what an illegal laboratory is?
scripts.translation: 這是非法實驗室。你知道這種地方是做什麼的

scripts.text: It would be used for illegal experiments with human life? Used like a lab rats?
scripts.translation: 嗎？用來進行非法人體實驗？把人當成實驗白鼠？

scripts.text: Aren't you imagining too much now.
scripts.translation: 你想像力未免太豐富了吧。

scripts.text: Our guard here and the VIP are not imaginative? I know you don't see to look at what's in front of you, but look at the reality of the situation here.
scripts.translation: 難道我們這位衛兵和貴賓就沒有想像力嗎？我知道你們不願看眼前的事實，但看看這裡到底是什麼情況。

scripts.text: Do you know what your colleagues ate and what they were doing before the day was over?
scripts.translation: 你知道你的同事們在一天結束前吃了什麼、做了什麼嗎？

scripts.text: Did the VIP know about the disappearance of his employees until I pushed to investigate about it?
scripts.translation: 要不是我堅持追查，你這位貴賓到現在還不知道自己的員工失蹤了吧？

scripts.text: I still cannot conclude that they're missing.
scripts.translation: 我仍然不能斷定他們失蹤了。

scripts.text: Alright, I see. Let's call it a problem, not a missing person. Do you feel better then? If it makes it easier for you, I'll call it that. Do you even want to solve this problem in a positive light?
scripts.translation: 好吧，我明白了。那就叫“出了問題”，不叫“有人失蹤”。這樣你就好受些了嗎？你喜歡的話，我就這麼說。可你真的想積極解決問題嗎？

scripts.text: Perfect, I had hoped you'd say that. I'm glad to see you're not angry anymore. So open your mind~ don't get angry~ breath slowly~ exhale~
scripts.translation: 太好了，我就盼著你這麼說。很高興你沒再生氣。放寬心~別生氣~慢慢吸氣~再撥出來~

scripts.text: If you're right, then let's check it out at the <NAVI>[Headquarters]<INFO>lhz_in01,107,137,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>.
scripts.translation: 如果你是對的，那我們就去<NAVI>[總部]<INFO>lhz_in01,107,137,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>看看吧。

scripts.text: The Rekenber roads are wide and gleaming~ everyone knows about the Schwarzwald Republic~
scripts.translation: 雷根修蘆的道路寬闊而閃亮~ 大家都知道修瓦魯茲巴魯德共和國~

scripts.text: Hello, how may I help you?
We've finally enter the Rekenber's headquarters. I wonder if Pat was relieved when he first passed through this door. Where did he go next?
scripts.translation: 我們終於進了雷肯貝爾總部。帕特第一次走進這扇門時，應該也鬆了口氣吧。他接下來去了哪裡？

scripts.text: Do all employees go through OT?
scripts.translation: 所有員工都要先參加入職

scripts.text: I thought they would assign them to their department directly.
scripts.translation: 培訓嗎？我還以為他們會直接分配到各自的部門。

scripts.text: Ah yes, you're right. For the special talented people, they must go through OT first and then they are assigned to their own respective department.
scripts.translation: 沒錯。特別人才得先參加入職培訓，之後才會分配到相應部門。

scripts.text: It's a system based on their ^0000FFplace of origin^000000. There are many people who are not familiar with the corporate culture. After many trials and errors, the new employees are now required to go through OT.
scripts.translation: 這是根據他們的出身背景制定的制度。很多人不熟悉企業文化，經過多次摸索調整，現在新員工都必須參加入職培訓。 ^0000FF^000000

scripts.text: Let's go the <NAVI>[Conference Room]<INFO>lhz_in01,162,257,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> where Pat started his life at Rekenber.
scripts.translation: 去<NAVI>[會議室]<INFO>lhz_in01,162,257,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>吧，帕特就是在那裡開始了雷肯貝爾的職業生涯。

scripts.text: I think the others went to the <NAVI>[Conference Room]<INFO>lhz_in01,162,257,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI>, where the meetings are held. Shouldn't you be going?
scripts.translation: 我想其他人去了<NAVI>[會議室]<INFO>lhz_in01,162,257,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI>，也就是開會的地方。你不也該過去嗎？

scripts.text: Do you need an assistance with something?
Let's ask this guy for information.
Do you know Kaufmann? Patrick Kaufmann.
scripts.translation: 你認識考夫曼嗎？帕特里克·考夫曼。

scripts.text: The Vice President is looking for Kaufmann.
scripts.translation: 副總裁正在尋找考夫曼。

scripts.text: I see, what is the purpose. And... who are you again?
scripts.translation: 哦，我明白了。找考夫曼有什麼事？還有...你剛才說你是誰來著？

scripts.text: Are you the secretary of the Vice President?
What are you talking about? Did your secretary get hit on the head? You sound like an outsider?
scripts.translation: 你在說什麼？你們秘書是不是撞到頭了？怎麼聽起來像個外行？
我在找帕特里克·考夫曼。

scripts.text: You, who are you... ? I've seen that face before... are you...?
scripts.translation: 你...你是誰？我好像在哪裡見過你...難道你是...？

scripts.text: Aaah! Yes, right, right!!! ...Vice President? Oh, hello!
scripts.translation: 啊！是的，沒錯，沒錯！！！...副總裁？哦，您好！

scripts.text: Do you know anything about Patrick Kaufmann?
scripts.translation: 你知道帕特里克·考夫曼的情況嗎？

scripts.text: Patrick Kaufmann... I know him. He's a good friend of mine. He has rough hands but his work is fast and accurate.
scripts.translation: 帕特里克·考夫曼...我認識他，是我的好朋友。他手掌粗糙，但幹活又快又準。我

scripts.text: I tried to keep him around longer, but they took him to the lab.
scripts.translation: 本想讓他多留一陣子，可他們把他調去實驗室了。

scripts.text: Yes, there. The newcomers must be in the company for ^0000FFat least a whole year^000000 before they can be sent to another department or a new workplace, unless they are given a ^0000FFspecial request.^000000
scripts.translation: 是的，就是那裡。新員工必須在公司工作至少整整一年，才能調往其他部門或工作地點，除非有特別調動申請。 ^0000FF^000000^0000FF^000000

scripts.text: But why would I send newcomers in the first place? I ignored the requests even though it came from above. But even so, some of the newcomers here were sent elsewhere anyway.
scripts.translation: 可我為什麼要調走新員工？上面發來調動要求時，我明明都拒絕了。即便如此，這裡的新人還是有一些被調走了。

scripts.text: Well you see... I need more people for repairs. There's always something broken, so I always need more manpower. But recently,
scripts.translation: 是這樣的...我需要更多人手維修裝置。這裡總有東西壞掉，所以一直缺人。可最近，

scripts.text: There's been ^0000FFa  lot more workforce requested.^000000
scripts.translation: FF申請調走的人手多了很多。 ^0000FF^000000

scripts.text: Do you know why so many people were drafted?
scripts.translation: 你知道為什麼這麼多人被抽調嗎？

scripts.text: I don't know for sure. Many people in our department get injured while working, and our newcomers are all very strong.
scripts.translation: 我也不清楚。我們部門有不少人工作時受傷，而新員工都很強壯。他們只調走那些

scripts.text: They only take those who are ^0000FFvery good at their job.^000000
But if you are pressured from above, you have to abide and give them the workforce, right?
scripts.translation: 可要是上面施壓，我們也只能服從，把人手交出去，對吧？

scripts.text: Which laboratory were they sent to?
scripts.translation: 他們被送到了哪個實驗室？

scripts.text: The annex one. Oh, do you want to go? I haven't been there in a while, it's quite hard to get inside. If you don't mind, could you send people back here?
scripts.translation: 是附屬實驗室。哦，你們要去那裡嗎？我很久沒去過了，進去不太容易。方便的話，能把那些人帶回來

scripts.text: Anyway, please be careful, it is a dangerous place.
scripts.translation: 嗎？總之要小心，那裡很危險。

scripts.text: Ooh.. You cannot be transferred at least until a whole year, unless you are given ^0000FFan unusual request.^000000
scripts.translation: 噢...除非有特別調動申請，否則至少要在公司幹滿一年 ^0000FF^000000

scripts.text: But Pat didn't get neither one of these reasons. Is it really a laboratory?
scripts.translation: 才能調崗。可帕特兩項都不符合。那地方真是實驗室嗎？

scripts.text: Did you know this VIP? was there anything about this in your documents? Why did the lab only take healthy and you people?
scripts.translation: 貴賓，你認識他嗎？資料裡有提到這件事嗎？實驗室為什麼只調走健康又年輕的人？

scripts.text: I need to know why they broke the contract rules.
scripts.translation: 我需要知道他們為什麼違反契約規定。

scripts.text: I was in charge of Regenschirm, but I've never seen Patrick Kaufmann.
scripts.translation: 我負責雷根修蘆，但從沒見過帕特里克·考夫曼。

scripts.text: Yeah? You're getting curious too now, aren't you! Is that right?
scripts.translation: 是嗎？你現在也開始好奇了吧？我說得沒錯吧？

scripts.text: I will guide you, follow me. Let's go to <NAVI>[Regenschirm]<INFO>rgsr_in,157,84,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>.
scripts.translation: 我帶你們過去，跟緊我。我們去<NAVI>[雷根修蘆]<INFO>rgsr_in,157,84,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>。

scripts.text: They are waiting for you at the <NAVI>[laboratory]<INFO>rgsr_in,157,84,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI>, shouldn't you go as well?
scripts.translation: 他們在<NAVI>[實驗室]<INFO>rgsr_in,157,84,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI>等你，你不也該去嗎？

scripts.text: There doesn't seem to be any room left.
scripts.translation: 看起來已經沒有空位了。

scripts.text: Adventurer, let's go quickly? Let's go together.
scripts.translation: 冒險者，快走吧！我們一起過去。

scripts.text: You came all the way to the office, what's going in? You left me alone in here and then just disappeared.
scripts.translation: 你們大老遠跑到辦公室來，到底想幹什麼？把我一個人留在這裡，自己卻不見了。為什麼

scripts.text: Do you know who's the gentlemen next to me?
scripts.translation: 你知道我身邊這位先生是誰嗎？

scripts.text: Ah! Nice to meet you. My name is Daisy. I'm an old friend of the Vice President.
scripts.translation: 啊！幸會，我叫黛西，是副總裁的老朋友。

scripts.text: Hello there. I'm called Gray Earl.
I'm usually not in these places, we should continue this meeting in the Vice President's office.
scripts.translation: 。我平時不在這裡辦公，我們去副總裁辦公室繼續談吧。

scripts.text: You don't have to. Here will be just fine. What are you doing in this place anyway? Were you waiting for someone?
scripts.translation: 不用了。在這裡就好。你在這裡做什麼？是在等什麼人嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, I noticed something odd about the Vice President's absence, so I went out to see what was going on.
scripts.translation: 是的，我注意到副總裁缺席有些不對勁，所以出去看看發生了什麼。

scripts.text: If you keep waiting outside like that, don't you think it looks even more suspicious?
scripts.translation: 如果你一直像那樣在外面等，難道不覺得更可疑嗎？

scripts.text: So you were hiding on purpose. Can you tell what this was all about?
scripts.translation: 所以你們是故意躲著我？能告訴我這到底是怎麼回事嗎？為

scripts.text: That was our plan. I'm cooperating with these people.
scripts.translation: 那是我們的計劃。我正在和這些人合作。

scripts.text: I didn't think we'd be friends with these people again.
scripts.translation: ！我沒想到我們還能和這些人再做朋友。

scripts.text: Why? Can't we be friends? You! You'll have to explain yourself!
scripts.translation: 為什麼不能做朋友？你！倒是得好好解釋一下！

scripts.text: You don't need to know more about this. The less you know, the better. When we finish the investigation, we'll let you know.
scripts.translation: 你不用知道太多，知道得越少越好。調查結束後，我們會告訴你。

scripts.text: So, do you know who's in charge of moving the workforce from one department to another? Is it someone you trust?
scripts.translation: 那麼，你知道誰負責跨部門調動員工嗎？那個人可靠嗎？

scripts.text: What are you saying about us?
What? Are we just garbage you can just throw away?
scripts.translation: 什麼？我們就像垃圾一樣可以隨便丟下嗎？

scripts.text: How many researcher are like us!

scripts.translation: 我不想任何人受傷！你們的武器會傷到我們的！

scripts.text: Why would you charge in without orders?

scripts.text: These are employees who help the laboratory run, but they do not believe when I tell them they've been conducting illegal experiments.

scripts.text: Alright. Let me talk to them.

scripts.text: Why is the Vice President here?
Were you all hired by the Rekenber institute to work on constructing and maintenance in this new lab?
scripts.translation: 你們是受雷肯貝爾研究所僱傭，來建造和維護這座新實驗室的嗎？

scripts.translation: 對，我是雷肯貝爾僱來的。

scripts.translation: 那邊穿藍衣服的人，你在這裡負責什麼工作？

scripts.text: Me? Well... I'm responsible for making and delivering foods to the people working here.
scripts.translation: 我嗎？嗯...我負責給這裡的工作人員做飯、送飯。

scripts.text: And what about the person next to you?
I carry waste materials and laboratory equipment.
scripts.translation: 我負責搬運廢料和實驗室裝置。

scripts.text: If you know what this place is studying, please raise your hand.
scripts.translation: 你們知道這裡究竟在研究什麼嗎？知道的話請舉手。

有時還會有奇怪的野獸經過。

scripts.text: While you do your own work, you don't know what this place is really for. in fact, I'm glad it's like that.
scripts.translation: 你們只管做好自己的工作，並不知道這裡真正的用途。說實話，我很慶幸如此。

scripts.translation: 你們不是應該代表正義的一方嗎？為什麼把我們當成壞人？

scripts.translation: 對吧？否則，副總裁不會派反叛者來，而是派衛兵。

scripts.translation: 我是說，你覺得研究員們是怎麼在這麼多年裡洗腦這些人的？

scripts.text: I'll talk to them, let me try.
scripts.translation: 我來跟他們談談，讓我試試。

scripts.translation: 大家好。我是泰斯，來自修瓦魯茲巴魯德總裁辦公室。

scripts.translation: 雷肯貝爾旗下的雷根修蘆實驗室也曾進行類似實驗，並因此引發騷亂

scripts.translation: 嗯...看來沒法輕易說服他們。我們先商量一下。

scripts.translation: 無論我怎麼勸說，他們都不肯聽。改變一個人的想法並不容易。我應該和泰斯商量一下。

scripts.translation: 副總裁卡雅·托斯要去勸他們。我們聽聽他怎麼說。

scripts.translation: 光靠言語是無法讓他們回頭的。

scripts.translation: 你不能對無辜的人使用武力。

scripts.translation: 即便如此，恐怕也只能這麼辦。我們分成兩隊，一隊攔住他們，另一隊進去繼續調查。

scripts.translation: 這裡的一切都是我的！別想傷害我的朋友！我可不是在開玩笑！

scripts.translation: 誰允許你靠近我的職員了？你看到了嗎？只要敢碰他們一下，我就把你炸上天。

scripts.translation: 為什麼？為什麼他們紋絲不動？那這個呢？

scripts.translation: 哦，我被擊中了！我們快逃吧！

scripts.translation: 他們怎麼這麼能打？難道我們挑錯實驗物件了？

scripts.translation: 我也是收錢辦事的專業人士！！沒空爭誰更厲害了，快跑！

scripts.translation: 我會把傷員轉移到安全的地方。

scripts.text: Let the rest of the people here look at where they went.
scripts.translation: 讓剩下的人在這裡檢視他們去了哪裡。

scripts.translation: 問題是，我們不能對他們動武。接下來怎麼辦？

scripts.translation: 你不是說雷肯貝爾的副總裁會去勸他們嗎？找我有什麼事？

scripts.translation: 我看這樣不行。泰斯會怎麼決定？那邊還在打呢。

scripts.text: It's dangerous here. Move over to the safe area!
scripts.translation: 這裡很危險。快轉移到安全區域去！

scripts.text: The Vice President is going to convince them.
scripts.translation: 副總裁會去勸服他們的。

scripts.translation: 泰斯不是讓你採取行動嗎？如果你還沒準備好，那就現在準備。

scripts.translation: 我很好奇裡面是什麼樣子的~

scripts.translation: 我有種不祥的預感。我們得做好準備。

scripts.translation: 這裡很安靜，也很舒服。要是能請一天假就好了...

scripts.translation: 我出來看看是什麼動靜，到底發生什麼事了？！

scripts.translation: 我不知道為什麼我一直站在這裡。如果他們問什麼，我就拒絕。他們的體力真好。

scripts.translation: 你看不到嗎？如果有空就幫忙幹活，沒時間解釋了。

scripts.translation: 我不行了...是首席研究員襲擊了我們。

scripts.translation: 這些東西都是我做的，我卻從來沒懷疑過...

scripts.text: Do you still trust the researchers? Is that what you're saying?
scripts.translation: 你還信那些研究員嗎？你是這個意思嗎？

scripts.text: No that's not it, I just can't believe it. Ugh, I'm so tired...
scripts.translation: 不，不是那樣，我只是不敢相信。唉，我好累...

scripts.text: Please stay here, I will check the surroundings.
scripts.translation: 請留在這裡，我去周圍檢視一下。

scripts.text: Take a look at the condition of the injured.

scripts.translation: 直接衝進來襲擊他們，真夠蠢的。他們到底在研究什麼？

scripts.translation: 因為我是實驗室裡唯一的機械師。我只關心自己的機器...

scripts.text: Now that I think about it, her eyes were not normal. She looks like a crazy person.
scripts.translation: 現在想想，她的眼神確實不正常，簡直像個瘋子。

scripts.text: Didn't you see <NAVI>[Aas]<INFO>sp_cor,135,147,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> going with the Vice President? I'm worried about the wounded people.
scripts.translation: 你沒看到<NAVI>[阿斯]<INFO>sp_cor,135,147,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>跟副總裁一起走了嗎？我得照看傷員。

scripts.text: It will take some time to finish the investigation and gather all the data here.
scripts.translation: 完成這裡的調查並收集所有資料還需要一些時間。

scripts.text: This place is very dangerous. Come back when you're strong enough to protect your own body.
scripts.translation: 這裡很危險。等你有能力保護自己後再回來。

scripts.text: I hope we can find all the missing people here. I really do.
scripts.translation: 我希望我們能找到這裡所有的失蹤者。我是真心的。

scripts.text: It looks like <NAVI>[Aas]<INFO>sp_cor,135,147,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> is concerned about the injured. Let's go see what she wants to talk about.
scripts.translation: 看起來<NAVI>[阿斯]<INFO>sp_cor,135,147,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>很擔心傷員。我們去看看她有什麼事。

scripts.translation: 不覺得這算是我的報應嗎？

scripts.text: Research and experimentation are not always safe. I thought I would be okay, but I couldn't avoid it in the end.
scripts.translation: 研究和實驗並不總是安全的。我以為自己不會出事，最後還是沒能逃過一劫。

scripts.text: The person who abandoned me here didn't think I'd still be alive.
scripts.translation: 把我丟在這裡的人沒想到我還活著。

scripts.text: Because the lab was crushed, toxic substances sprung up all over the place.
scripts.translation: 實驗室被壓毀後，有毒物質洩漏得到處都是。

scripts.text: Eheh. So I'm just going to wait here and die like this. I wanted to surprise the would with my research, but I ended up living here instead.
scripts.translation: 呵呵，我就待在這裡等死吧。本想用研究震驚世界，結果卻落得在這裡苟活。

scripts.text: Are there any other people here?
Why are you looking for? A dead person? A living person? Or perhaps a half dead person?
scripts.translation: 你在找什麼？死人？活人？還是半死不活的人？

scripts.text: How many discarded people do you think you'll find here?
scripts.translation: 你覺得這裡能找到多少個被遺棄的人？

scripts.text: If they had a ^0000FFcertain physical condition and a poor background^000000, sometimes just homeless, it was easier to experiment on them.
scripts.translation: 只要他們身體狀況特殊、家境貧寒，有時甚至無家可歸，拿來做實驗就更容易了。 ^0000FF^000000

scripts.text: Don't look at me like that. The poorer you are, the better off your family is, we would be fools to not take advantage of these people. At least that's what I thought back then.
scripts.translation: 別這樣看我。你越窮，家人反而越能過上好日子；不利用這些人，我們才是傻子。至少當時我是這麼想的。

scripts.text: Where do you think all these missing people have gone to over the years?
scripts.translation: 你覺得這些年來，所有失蹤的人都去了哪裡？

scripts.text: Many of the missing people of Schwarzwald would end up here. Are you going to investigate every single one of them? If you had enough time, it wouldn't be a bad thing.
scripts.translation: 修瓦魯茲巴魯德有很多失蹤者最後都被送到這裡。你打算一個個查嗎？有時間的話，倒也不妨查查。

scripts.text: Or are you only looking for one person in particular?
scripts.translation: 還是說，你只是在找特定的某一個人？
我在找帕特里克·考夫曼。

scripts.text: Well.. I ^0000FFdon't have the information you seek.^000000 I was the last person to come here.
scripts.translation: 嗯...我沒有你要找的訊息。我是最後一個被送到這裡的人。 ^0000FF^000000

scripts.text: I don't have much to do, but I've looked through this place and I haven't seen anyone by that that... you know what I mean?
scripts.translation: 我沒什麼事做，已經把這裡找遍了，也沒見到你說的那個人...你懂我的意思吧？

scripts.text: You should try and look for an ^0000FFIdentification Bracelet^000000 in the pile of garbage. DO you know what it is?
scripts.translation: 你可以在垃圾堆裡找找身份識別手鐲。知道那是什麼 ^0000FF^000000

scripts.text: The wrist band is a bracelet. The names of the specimens are written on it.
scripts.translation: 嗎？那是戴在手腕上的手環，上面寫著實驗體的名字。

scripts.text: If he did, there would be a bracelet somewhere on the floor. It might not even be there anymore...
scripts.translation: 如果他有手鐲，地上應該會留著一個。不過現在可能已經找不到了...

scripts.text: If you can't find him, you can probably just buy a bracelet at a market and have a proper burial instead.
scripts.translation: 如果找不到他，或許可以去市場買個手鐲，至少給他辦場像樣的葬禮。

scripts.text: ... why am I not going? I did everything I wanted to do here.
scripts.translation: ...我為什麼還不走？想做的事明明都做完了。

scripts.text: Leaving this place? Don't, I'm dying. It's the gruesome truth. I know my body well. It's what I studied.
scripts.translation: 離開這裡？別費心了，我快死了。這就是殘酷的事實。我很瞭解自己的身體，畢竟我研究的就是這個。

scripts.text: For now, my foot is like this, but the other leg will change soon.
scripts.translation: 現在只有一隻腳變成這樣，但另一條腿很快也會變

scripts.text: Then both of my arms... and at the end... can you still call me humans?
scripts.translation: 。接著是雙臂...最後...你還會把我當人看嗎？

scripts.text: Even if I received treatments, there's no chance I'd survive. I know this well. Wouldn't it be best for me to have a quiet life here without anyone?
scripts.translation: 就算接受治療，我也活不了。我很清楚。與其被人打擾，不如獨自在這裡安靜度過餘生，不是更好嗎？

scripts.text: See, this is my family now. Why do I have to carry such a heavy load? It's a hundred times easier to give up hope than to be alive elsewhere isn't it?
scripts.translation: 你看，這裡就是我的家。揹負這麼沉重的希望又有什麼意義？放棄希望，可比在別處多苟活一會兒輕鬆一百倍，對吧？

scripts.text: Do I sound weird when I say stuff like that? I think I'm losing it a little.
scripts.translation: 我這麼說是不是很奇怪？我覺得自己快撐不住了。

scripts.text: Yes, sometimes I even dream of taking people out of their misery.
scripts.translation: 是啊，有時候我甚至會想，幫那些人結束痛苦。

scripts.text: It's not probably what their family would have wanted, but it's dangerous outside for them. You know what I mean?
scripts.translation: 他們的家人或許不希望這樣，可外面對他們來說太危險了。你懂我的意思吧？

scripts.text: And... I don't think it's a coincidence.
scripts.translation: 而且...我覺得這不是巧合。

scripts.text: If you come back here after a while and I'm completely turned into a monster, please kill me.
scripts.translation: 如果你過些日子回來，發現我已經徹底變成魔物，就殺了我吧。

scripts.text: I would have rather have my life cut off short than living just a second as a monster. Got it?
scripts.translation: 我寧願就此死去，也不願哪怕多一秒以魔物的樣子活著。明白嗎？

scripts.text: Huh. Surprisingly, I told you a lot. I should rest.
scripts.translation: 呵，沒想到我說了這麼多。我得休息了。

scripts.text: You should try and look for an ^0000FFIdentification Bracelet^000000 in the pile of garbage. Do you know what it is?
scripts.translation: 去垃圾堆裡找找身份識別手鐲吧。知道那是什 ^0000FF^000000

scripts.text: The wrist band is a bracelet. And that is where the names of the specimens are written.
scripts.translation: 麼嗎？那是戴在手腕上的手環，上面寫著實驗體的名字。

scripts.text: I looked through the garbage and found several identification bracelet. Let's look elsewhere.
scripts.translation: 我翻了翻垃圾，找到幾個身份識別手鐲。去別處看看吧。

scripts.text: I don't think there's anything here related to Kaufmann.
scripts.translation: 這裡好像沒有和考夫曼有關的東西。

scripts.text: I looked through the pile, I found nothing but garbage.
scripts.translation: 我翻遍了那堆東西，除了垃圾什麼也沒找到。

scripts.text: I digged a bracelet buried in a pile of garbage. This seems to be an identification bracelet from the experiments. It says... Pat... Patrick... Kauf...man.
scripts.translation: 我從垃圾堆裡挖出一隻手鐲，應該是實驗用的身份識別手鐲。上面寫著...帕特...帕特里克...考夫...曼。

scripts.text: This is Patrick Kaufmann's bracelet... let's go back to <NAVI>[Kaya]<INFO>sp_cor,136,146,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>.
scripts.translation: 這是帕特里克·考夫曼的手鐲...回去找<NAVI>[卡雅]<INFO>sp_cor,136,146,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>吧。

scripts.text: I looked through the pile, there was nothing there.
scripts.translation: 我翻遍了那堆東西，那裡什麼都沒有。

scripts.text: I've already seen this place. Let's look elsewhere.
scripts.translation: 這個地方已經找過了。去別處看看吧。

scripts.text: This place seems like a dead end.
Oh you're here. I heard that the recon team has taken control over the railroad transport route.
scripts.translation: 哦，你來了。我聽說偵察隊已經控制了鐵路運輸線。

scripts.text: We took control of the transport route, but they'll probably fight back in a few hours. Then, it would make the operation useless.
scripts.translation: 我們雖然控制了運輸線，但他們大概幾小時後就會反撲。到時候這次行動就白費了。

scripts.text: We are planning to carry out an all-out battle on the surrounding area to prevent a counterattack. Of course the civilians won't be included...
scripts.translation: 我們打算在周邊地區展開全面作戰，防止敵人反擊。當然，會讓平民撤離...

scripts.text: Ask what you need to prepare.
The briefing will be held after we enter the operational area. Make sure you bring the supplies you need.
scripts.translation: 進入行動區域後會進行簡報。記得帶齊所需補給。

scripts.text: We've taken control of the route, they'll probably fight back in a few hours.
scripts.translation: 我們控制了路線，他們大概幾個小時後就會反擊。

scripts.text: ^FF0000Please note that, any abnormal monster handling inside the instance such as taming is not considered normal and may hinder the instance progress.^000000
scripts.translation: 請注意，在副本中馴服魔物等異常行為不屬於正常操作，可能會妨礙副本進度。 ^FF0000^000000

scripts.text: ^FF0000In beginners mode, the player transform into a monster. Please not that existing transformation effect will disappear after entering and proceeding.^000000
scripts.translation: 初學者模式下，玩家會變身為魔物。進入副本並繼續後，已有的變身效果會消失。 ^FF0000^000000

scripts.text: Are you alone? It's difficult if you're alone. Form a party, make a unit, and start.
scripts.translation: 你是一個人嗎？獨自行動會很困難。組隊並編成小隊後再開始吧。

scripts.text: Inspect your unit before we enter for the occupation.
scripts.translation: 進入佔領區域前，先檢查一下小隊情況。

scripts.text: The preparation for the operation is not yet complete or your party is performing another operation.
scripts.translation: 行動準備尚未完成，或你的隊伍正在執行其他行動。

scripts.text: ^FF0000Please note that, any abnormal monster handling inside the instance such as taming is not considered normal and may hinder the instance progress.^000000
scripts.translation: 請注意，在副本中馴服魔物等異常行為不屬於正常操作，可能會妨礙副本進度。 ^FF0000^000000

scripts.text: It's not time for the operation yet, just rest for now.
scripts.translation: 現在還不是行動時間，先休息一下吧。

scripts.text: Even though we suppressed the enemy from the first annihilation operation, the mutants started crawling out again.
scripts.translation: 第一次殲滅行動雖然壓制了敵人，但變異體又開始不斷湧出來了。

scripts.text: It will be easier if we can destroy the source. But those on the top won't approve it, so we'll have to begin a secondary search.
scripts.translation: 要是能摧毀源頭就好了。但上級不會批准，我們只能開始第二輪搜尋。

scripts.text: I hope the search will be completed safely.
scripts.translation: 希望搜尋一切順利，大家都能平安回來。

scripts.text: Are you alone? It's difficult if you're alone. Form a party, make a unit, and start.
scripts.translation: 你是一個人嗎？獨自行動會很困難。組隊並編成小隊後再開始吧。

scripts.text: Perform a last unit check before the search.
scripts.translation: 搜尋開始前，最後檢查一下小隊。

scripts.text: The preparation for the operation is not yet complete or your party is performing another operation.
scripts.translation: 行動準備尚未完成，或你的隊伍正在執行其他行動。

scripts.text: Ah, Adventurer! Long time, no see! Didn't you miss me?
scripts.translation: 啊，冒險者！好久不見！你沒想我嗎？

scripts.text: Ah, you're so cold, Adventurer. Don't be like that.
scripts.translation: 啊，你可真冷淡，冒險者。別這樣嘛。

scripts.text: I'm on watch duty here, to keep strangers away.
scripts.translation: 我在這裡值守，負責攔住陌生人。

scripts.text: But since you're not a stranger, I'll let you pass.
scripts.translation: 不過你不是陌生人，我就放你過去

scripts.text: You've got weapons and armor that match your class, and you're wearing warm clothes. Pass!
scripts.translation: 。武器和防具都符合你的職業，還穿得夠暖和。可以通過！

scripts.text: Mina said you can come back later. It's too early for his lovely children to be up and about.
scripts.translation: 米娜說你可以晚點再來。現在還太早，她那些可愛的孩子們還沒起床活動呢。

scripts.text: ... The security devices and traps that summon monsters are still in low power mode. Leave them alone, or they can get easily overheated.
scripts.translation: ...召喚魔物的安保裝置和陷阱還處於低功耗模式。別碰它們，否則很容易過熱。

scripts.text: Please come back after dawn when Mina's children wake up and get ready for another energetic day!
scripts.translation: 等天亮、米娜的孩子們醒來，準備好迎接新一天後再回來吧！

scripts.text: They'll be fully charged after dawn, and ready to operate again. Come back, then.
scripts.translation: 天亮後它們就會充滿電，恢復運作。到時候再回來。

scripts.text: Oh, Adventurer! Long time, no see! Actually, I'd like to ask you something. It's about Mina.
scripts.translation: 哦，冒險者！好久不見！我有件事想問你，是關於米娜的。

scripts.text: Just let me explain. When you came after me, my machines that used to protect me--
scripts.translation: 聽我解釋。你來追我的時候，那些保護我的機器——

scripts.text: No, we didn't catch Mina's machines. They've been in hiding, sleeping.
scripts.translation: 不，我們沒抓到米娜的機器。它們一直藏著，處於休眠狀態。

scripts.text: It's Elyumina's! Elyumina's machines! And traps! ... They go stealth in low power mode in case of emergency. And it's time that they show back up and start rampaging again.
scripts.translation: 那是我的機器！艾露米娜的機器！還有陷阱！...它們遇到緊急情況時會進入低功耗隱匿模式。現在它們要重新現身，再次大鬧一場了。

scripts.text: It's Elyumina, and I can't do it! They're equipped with a high-tech machine learning module.
scripts.translation: 是艾露米娜！而且我控制不了它們！它們裝有高科技機器學習

scripts.text: Since that day, they used data about you, their most powerful enemy, and they've used it to grow rapidly.
scripts.translation: 模組。從那天起，它們一直收集你這個最強敵人的資料，飛快地進化。

scripts.text: I can't control them! ... This is completely unexpected.
scripts.translation: 我控制不了它們！...這完全出乎意料

scripts.text: The only solution I can think of is to exhaust their batteries until they stop working.
scripts.translation: 。我唯一能想到的辦法，就是耗光它們的電池，讓它們停下來。

scripts.text: And the only person who can do it is you. You beat the EL1_A17T. Of course, I'll go with you, but I'll only be there to collect new data from them.
scripts.translation: 只有你能辦到。你打敗過EL1_A17T。我當然也會同行，不過只是去收集它們的新資料。

scripts.text: I'd love to go too, but Mina won't let me. I wonder if it's because he cares.
scripts.translation: 我也很想去，可米娜不讓我去。是不是因為他關心我呢？

scripts.text: Anyway, I don't think you can handle them by yourself.
scripts.translation: 總之，我覺得你一個人對付不了它

scripts.text: That hooligan who detained me that day also won't be enough. Come back in a party with other adventurers, will you?
scripts.translation: 們。那天扣留我的那個莽漢也不夠。和其他冒險者組隊再回來，好嗎？

scripts.text: Then, we've at least got four, including me and Mina--
scripts.translation: 那麼，至少我們得有四個，包括我和米娜——

scripts.text: I'll give you more details when we're inside. Please, say yes!
scripts.translation: 進去後我會詳細說明。拜託了，答應吧！求你

scripts.text: Please! Before he gives me a coronary!
scripts.translation: 了！別讓他把我氣出心臟病！

scripts.text: It's time Mina's children are up and about, Adventurer.
scripts.translation: 冒險者，米娜的孩子們該起床活

scripts.text: Do you want to play with them and tuck them back into bed while everyone else waits for you to finish?
scripts.translation: 動了。要不要陪它們玩玩，等大家忙完再把它們哄回床上？

scripts.text: ... Soon, my security devices and traps will come out of their low power mode and become mobile again.
scripts.translation: ...很快，我的安保裝置和陷阱就會退出低功耗模式，重新活動起來。

scripts.text: Do you want to lock down Cor, exhaust them, and collect data again?
scripts.translation: 你想封鎖柯爾，耗光它們的電量，再收集一輪數

scripts.text: Please say yes. Let me follow you. I can't wait to get away from this guy.
scripts.translation: 據嗎？答應吧，讓我跟你去。我真受不了那傢伙了。

scripts.text: Mm, I'm sorry to hear that. Adventurer, if you'd like to join the operation, then as the leader of the party, please select Ready.
scripts.translation: 嗯，真遺憾。冒險者，想參加行動的話，請讓隊伍首領選擇“準備”。

scripts.text: And after the Memorial dungeon is created and all your party members select Enter, you can select Enter to start the operation.
scripts.translation: 記憶副本建立後，所有隊員都選擇“進入”，你再選擇“進入”就能開始行動。

scripts.text: ^ff0000Please note that you can't clear this dungeon if you try to tame monsters or perform any other irrelevant monster-related activities.^000000
scripts.translation: 請注意：馴服魔物或進行其他無關的魔物相關活動，會導致你無法完成此副本。 ^ff0000^000000

scripts.text: Mm? Mina doesn't think you can do this alone. Please come back in a party, Adventurer.
scripts.translation: 嗯？米娜覺得你一個人應付不了。冒險者，請組隊後再來。

scripts.text: There seems to be a problem. Your request has failed. Please try again later. If the problem persists, please contact the Operation Team.
scripts.translation: 好像出了點問題，申請失敗了。請稍後再試。如果問題仍未解決，請聯絡運營團隊。

scripts.text: Alright, if MD is activated, talk to me again and select ^0000CDEnter^000000. Our operation will begin as soon as you enter.
scripts.translation: 副本開啟後，再來找我並選擇進入。你一進入，行動就會開始。 ^0000CD^000000

scripts.text: The dungeon is not yet created. Let me check again.
scripts.translation: 副本還沒建立好，我再確認一下。

scripts.text: Your party leader hasn't created the dungeon. Let me check again.
scripts.translation: 隊長還沒有建立副本，我再確認一下。

scripts.text: An unknown error has occurred. Let's check it again.
scripts.translation: 發生了未知錯誤，我們再檢查一下。

scripts.text: What are you doing? Come on, let's go. Please? I don't want to stay even a moment longer with that jerk who keeps calling me by that terrible nickname.
scripts.translation: 你還在磨蹭什麼？快走吧，求你了！我一刻也不想再和那個老用討厭綽號叫我的混蛋待在一起。

scripts.text: Hm? I think we need to clean up the Heart Hunters in the area.
scripts.translation: 嗯？我們得清理這附近的心之獵手

scripts.text: Aren't you participating in the next operation?
Special forces are on the lookout already, but they haven't found a laboratory...
scripts.translation: 。特種部隊已經在搜尋，但還沒找到實驗室...

scripts.text: How do the Heart Hunters come back so fast?
scripts.translation: 心之獵手怎麼這麼快又冒出來了

scripts.text: I think we should fight again soon, but for now let's take a break.
scripts.translation: ？我們很快還得再打一場，不過現在先休息吧。

scripts.text: Let's prepare for a Heart Hunter hunt.
When you're ready, let's go again.
Please handle 15 ^0000FFHeart Hunter Bellares and  Heart Hunter Sanares.^000000
scripts.translation: 請擊敗15只心之獵手貝拉蕾和15只心之獵手薩納蕾。 ^0000FF^000000

scripts.text: I want to get battle information.
You can follow the track from there.
scripts.translation: 裡順著蹤跡找過去就行。

scripts.text: These guys were stronger than expected.
It seems like their equipment or abilities have increased in various ways.
scripts.translation: 強。看來它們的裝備或能力都有所強化。

scripts.text: I wonder if those were strengthened through the experimentation in this lab?
scripts.translation: 它們是不是在這間實驗室裡被強化過？現在強

scripts.text: They've become so strong now, I don't trust these people...
scripts.translation: 得驚人，我可不信任那些人...

scripts.text: Thank you very much for today's work.
scripts.translation: 非常感謝你今天的工作。現

scripts.text: The Heart Hunters Bellares and the Sanares are not like those we've met before.
scripts.translation: 心之獵手貝拉蕾和薩納蕾跟我們之前遇到的完全不

scripts.text: They are hard to deal with.
Because of that, the Est special troops are hiding in the battlefield to advance further.
scripts.translation: 為了繼續推進，埃斯特的特種部隊正躲在戰場裡。要對

scripts.text: We have to deal with those guys, sometimes it's hard.
scripts.translation: 付這些傢伙，有時還真不容易。

scripts.text: The adventurer should take a break.
Will you able to deal with Heart Hunter Bellares and Sanares properly?
scripts.translation: 能對付心之獵手貝拉蕾和薩納蕾嗎

scripts.text: Please hunt down 15 of each Heart Hunters.
I want to gather more combat data if possible.
scripts.translation: 如果可以的話，我還想收集更多戰

scripts.text: Sorry, I'm busy. I don't think you city people want to be here because it smells like fertilizer. Why don't you go over there and join the others where the researchers used to be?
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我正忙。你們這些城裡人肯定不想待在這兒，肥料味可不好聞。去那邊和研究員以前待的地方的人會合吧。

scripts.text: We're here to grow vegetables. This self-sufficient farm is our pride and joy.
scripts.translation: 我們在這裡種蔬菜。這個自給自足的農場是我們的驕傲。

scripts.text: But since this incident, many members in our staff have requested a transfer, leaving us short-staffed. Would you be so kind as to help us tend to our crops?
scripts.translation: 出了這事以後，好多人都申請調走了，現在人手不夠。能不能幫我們照料一下莊稼？

scripts.text: You big shots came here and ruined our peace.
scripts.translation: 你們這些大人物一來，就把我們的安穩日子攪黃了。

scripts.text: Ban, forget it. What we had prob'bly wasn't real peace, anyway.
scripts.translation: 算了，別提了。說不定我們以前過的也算不上安穩日子。

scripts.text: Thank you! We grow grapes, green beans, and pumpkins in our farm, and they each have different needs.
scripts.translation: 謝啦！我們種葡萄、四季豆和南瓜，它們各有各的照料方法。

scripts.text: For the grapes, please {0}. For the green beans, {1}. And for the pumpkins, {2}.
scripts.translation: 葡萄要，四季豆要，南瓜要。 {0}{1}{2}

scripts.text: Then, I'll be countin' on you.
- Your bag is full. Please check your weight and carrying item quantity, and then talk to me again. -
scripts.translation: - 你的背包已滿。請檢查你的負重和攜帶物品數量，然後再次與我交談。 -

scripts.text: You took care of them all. For an adventurer, you're pretty good at tendin' to gardens.
scripts.translation: 全都照料好了。你一個冒險者還挺會打理菜園嘛。

scripts.text: We don't have anythin' to give you, but maybe you could have these components that we've found around here. I saw the mercenaries collectin' them. Don't you need them, too?
scripts.translation: 我們沒什麼好送你的，不過可以把在附近找到的這些零件給你。我看見傭兵在收集它們，你應該也用得上吧？

scripts.text: Our crops need to be tended every day. Please come back and help us again.
scripts.translation: 莊稼每天都得照料。記得回來再幫我們一次。

scripts.text: For the grapes, you have to {0}. For the green beans, {1}. And for the pumpkins, {2}.
scripts.translation: 對於葡萄，你必須。對於青豆，。對於南瓜，。 {0}{1}{2}

scripts.text: Please make sure you do all these.
Our crops are good for now. Messin' with them too often ain't good for them. They may not look it, but they're pretty sensitive.
scripts.translation: 莊稼現在長得不錯。別老去折騰它們，雖然看不出來，其實都很嬌貴。

scripts.text: Please come back after dawn. Thank you.
Enough time has passed for our crops to need tendin' again. Would you help us again?
scripts.translation: 又到該照料莊稼的時候了。能再幫我們一次嗎？

scripts.text: Since you came along, I've been havin' more things to do, and there's only so much one man can do.
scripts.translation: 你來了以後，我手頭的活兒更多了，可人手就這麼多。

scripts.text: Ah, I understand. Thanks to you guys, I've got more things to do with fewer men to do them with, but I'm alright.
scripts.translation: 啊，明白了。多虧你們，人手少了，活兒反而多了...不過我還能應付。

scripts.text: Well, forget it. You're prob'bly too busy yourself. But what do I know? I'm just a farmhand.
scripts.translation: 算了，你大概也忙得很。不過我懂什麼呢？我不過是個農場幫工。

scripts.text: Thank you. We've got grapes, green beans, and pumpkins, and I believe I've told you they each have different needs.
scripts.translation: 謝謝。我們種葡萄、四季豆和南瓜，之前應該告訴過你，它們各有不同的需求。

scripts.text: For the grapes, please {0}. For the green beans, {1}. And for the pumpkins, {2}. Since you know the drill, I won't say more.
scripts.translation: 葡萄要，四季豆要，南瓜要。你已經知道怎麼做了，我就不多說了。 {0}{1}{2}

scripts.text: Sorry, I'm busy. I don't think you city people want to be here because it smells like fertilizer. Why don't you go over there and join the others where the researchers used to be?
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我正忙。你們這些城裡人肯定不想待在這兒，肥料味可不好聞。去那邊和研究員以前待的地方的人會合吧。

scripts.text: Small green beans are hanging from the healthy-looking beanstalks.
scripts.translation: 長勢良好的豆藤上掛著一顆顆小豆莢。

scripts.text: Small green beans are hanging from the rejuvenated beanstalks.
scripts.translation: 恢復生機的豆藤上掛著一顆顆小豆莢。

scripts.text: These green beans look a little bit lifeless.
scripts.translation: 這些四季豆看起來有點蔫。

scripts.text: I caught aphids on the green bean stalks.
scripts.translation: 我捉掉了豆藤上的蚜蟲。

scripts.text: I spread fertilizer around the green beans.
I pulled weeds around the green beans.
scripts.translation: 我把四季豆周圍的雜草拔掉了。

scripts.text: Why do they still look wilted?
Oooh, I can tell the green beans are happy now!
scripts.translation: 噢，看得出來，四季豆現在長得很開心！

scripts.text: I've tended to all the crops. I should go back to the Farmhand.
scripts.translation: 莊稼都照料好了。我該回去找農場幫工了。

scripts.text: Small, fussy leaves have grown out of the healthy-looking pumpkin vines.
scripts.translation: 長勢良好的南瓜藤上長出了嫩嫩的小葉子。

scripts.text: Small, fussy leaves have grown out of the rejuvenated pumpkin vines.
scripts.translation: 恢復生機的南瓜藤上長出了嫩嫩的小葉子。

scripts.text: These pumpkin vines look a little bit lifeless.
scripts.translation: 這些南瓜藤看起來有點蔫。

scripts.text: I caught aphids on the pumpkin vines.
scripts.translation: 我捉掉了南瓜藤上的蚜蟲。

scripts.text: I spread fertilizer on the pumpkin vines.
I pulled weeds around the pumpkin vines.
scripts.translation: 我把南瓜藤周圍的雜草拔掉了。

scripts.text: Why do they still look wilted?
Oooh, I can tell the pumpkins are happy now!
scripts.translation: 噢，看得出來，南瓜現在長得很開心！

scripts.text: I've tended to all the crops. I should go back to the Farmhand.
scripts.translation: 莊稼都照料好了。我該回去找農場幫工了。

scripts.text: Clusters of small green grapes are hanging from the healthy-looking grapevines.
scripts.translation: 長勢良好的葡萄藤上掛著一串串小小的青葡萄。

scripts.text: Clusters of small green grapes are hanging from the rejuvenated grapevines.
scripts.translation: 恢復生機的葡萄藤上掛著一串串小小的青葡萄。

scripts.text: These grapes look a little bit lifeless.
scripts.translation: 這些葡萄看起來有些蔫了。

scripts.text: I caught aphids on the grapevines.
scripts.translation: 我把葡萄藤上的蚜蟲捉掉了。

scripts.text: I spread fertilizer around the grapes.
I pulled weeds around the grapes.
scripts.translation: 我把葡萄周圍的雜草拔掉了。

scripts.text: Why do they still look wilted?
scripts.translation: 怎麼還是一副蔫巴巴的樣子？

scripts.text: Oooh, I can tell the grapes are happy now!
scripts.translation: 噢！葡萄看起來精神多了！

scripts.text: I've tended to all the crops. I should go back to the Farmhand.
scripts.translation: 莊稼都照料好了，該回去找農場幫工了。

scripts.text: Do you need help? If you have business with the <NAVI>[Rebellion]<INFO>sp_cor,127,140,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>, then head southwest.
scripts.translation: 需要幫忙嗎？要找<NAVI>[反叛者]<INFO>sp_cor,127,140,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>的話，請往西南方走

scripts.text: In the southeast, there's the <NAVI>[plantation]<INFO>sp_cor,243,84,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> that we believe to exist for food supply and research purposes.
scripts.translation: 。東南方有一處<NAVI>[種植園]<INFO>sp_cor,243,84,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>，據我們推測，那是用來供應食物和進行研究的。

scripts.text: The <NAVI>[tents]<INFO>sp_cor,159,220,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> in the northwest are dangerous. Please stay away from them. The same goes for the <NAVI>[waterway]<INFO>sp_cor,236,275,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> in the northeast.
scripts.translation: 西北方的<NAVI>[帳篷]<INFO>sp_cor,159,220,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>很危險，請不要靠近。東北方的<NAVI>[水道]<INFO>sp_cor,236,275,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>也一樣。

scripts.text: Finally, it's time for Lucky Rookie to shine. Ooh, can't wait!
scripts.translation: 終於輪到幸運新人發光發熱了。噢，我都等不及了！

scripts.text: Since this is an important interrogation, there should be as many government agents present as the others, to prevent miscommunication later.
scripts.translation: 這次審訊事關重大，為免日後出現誤會，政府方面也應該安排足夠的人員到場。

scripts.text: I wonder how valuable these things are. How much do they cost? I want to touch and smell them. They smell and feel like valuables, I bet!
scripts.translation: 這些東西肯定很值錢吧？到底值多少？我真想摸摸、聞聞看。摸起來、聞起來都像貴重物品，我敢說沒錯！

scripts.text: They're probably only valuable to scientists and researchers. You'd better not touch them. You could lose your hands.
scripts.translation: 這些東西大概只有科學家和研究員才會覺得有價值。最好別碰，不然可能會把手弄沒。

scripts.text: I decided to go along with the adventurer's suggestion and conduct a new investigation. But I wonder if I made the right choice.
scripts.translation: 我決定採納冒險者的建議，重新展開調查。但不知道這個決定是否正確。

scripts.text: Daisy, I don't like his eyes and his manner of speech. Are all government people like this?
scripts.translation: 黛西，我不喜歡他的眼神和說話方式。政府裡的人都這樣嗎？

scripts.text: I don't know what the Vice President is thinking... But I'm going with him, even if I don't have to.
scripts.translation: 我不知道副總統在想什麼......不過我還是會跟著他，哪怕其實不必如此。

scripts.text: I can't stand now, I was soaked in blood earlier. I would have followed them but I couldn't stand.
scripts.translation: 我現在站不起來，剛才渾身都被血浸透了。本來想跟著他們走，可實在站不起來。

scripts.text: Hey, what the hell is this commotion all about?
scripts.translation: 喂，這到底鬧的是哪一齣？

scripts.text: For whom and for what have I been working for... they have so much resources...
scripts.translation: 我究竟是為了誰、為了什麼在工作......他們的資源竟然這麼充足......

scripts.text: You can rest assured, there are eyes everywhere here. I'm being careful.
scripts.translation: 放心吧，這裡到處都是眼線，我會小心行事。

scripts.text: It's safe here. Even if it's a big place, they won't attack randomly.
scripts.translation: 這裡很安全。地方再大，他們也不會貿然發動攻擊。

scripts.text: If we're going to have a raid next time, we'll have to be thorough.
scripts.translation: 下次要是再突襲，就得徹底搜查一遍。

scripts.text: There's nothing that stands out in this location!
scripts.translation: 這地方沒什麼特別顯眼的東西！

scripts.text: Scientists, researchers, everyone here just pretends things are fine.
scripts.translation: 科學家、研究員......這裡所有人都裝作一切安好。

scripts.text: Arthur, don't touch these or your hands will melt.
scripts.translation: 亞瑟，別碰那些東西，不然你的手會融化。

scripts.text: Are these expensive? I want to see them closer! I want to smell it!
scripts.translation: 這些東西很貴嗎？我想湊近看看！還想聞聞！
真有種貴重物品的感覺！

scripts.text: I can't go now, but when I'm old enough, I'll go and work. I don't have time to play.
scripts.translation: 我現在還不能去，等長大了就去工作。我可沒工夫玩。

scripts.text: What? Is this your first time here?
The drinks come from over there.
This place is for adults only.
What? Are you the guy they're waiting for? You see the room behind me? Go ahead and go in.
scripts.translation: 什麼？你就是他們等的人嗎？看到我身後的房間了嗎？進去吧。

scripts.text: Are you going in? It's pretty loud so I'll go in later.
scripts.translation: 你要進去嗎？裡面挺吵的，我晚點再進去。

scripts.text: Wait nobody is back there now, are you waiting for someone?
scripts.translation: 等等，裡面現在沒人。你是在等誰嗎？

scripts.text: Are you going to the backroom?
I'm sorry, but you're not allowed to go inside.
It's dangerous at the moment because the mine is closed.
scripts.translation: 目前已經封閉，現在很危險。

scripts.text: This way, I'll let you in the mines.
It's more secure than I thought.
scripts.translation: 呢。這比我想的牢固多了。

scripts.text: - You're not allowed to enter this area. -
